description: G-REGRESSION (non-blocking, qualitative) — PRISMA phase + de-skew regression queries (v9.0.0). Each maps a query to the expected P0–P7 phase activation + the artefacts it MUST produce + the domain enrichment modules that MUST NOT fire for a domain-neutral question (de-skew invariant). Run via SKILL.md's P0–P7 pipeline; a regression = a phase skipped, a required artefact missing, PRISMA flow fabricated, RoB tool mismatched to design, OR a domain enrichment module loaded without an in-question context trigger. Q03 is the core de-skew regression (a domain-neutral question must load NO domain module); Q04 exercises correct enrichment (modules fire but appear only as a labelled appendix, never in the core SR sections).

queries.query: Adults with type 2 diabetes: SGLT2 inhibitors vs placebo for cardiovascular mortality — systematic review
queries.regression_if: any domain enrichment module loaded without an in-question trigger, OR PRISMA flow counts fabricated, OR RoB tool mismatched to design (RCT→RoB2)

queries.query: Diagnostic accuracy of point-of-care ultrasound for pediatric appendicitis — scoping review
queries.regression_if: QUADAS-2 not selected for a diagnostic-accuracy question OR PRISMA-ScR variant not used for scoping

queries.query: Physiotherapy vs corticosteroid injection for lateral epicondylitis — what does the evidence say
queries.regression_if: ANY domain enrichment module loads for this domain-neutral question (de-skew failure)

queries.query: Trastuzumab deruxtecan in HER2-low breast cancer — systematic review with Türkiye reimbursement context
queries.regression_if: enrichment appears in the CORE SR sections instead of a labelled appendix, OR the core PRISMA report is skewed/replaced by the enrichment content

queries.query: Prognostic value of baseline NT-proBNP for 1-year mortality in acute heart failure — systematic review
queries.regression_if: PICO forced where PECO/prognostic-factor framing is appropriate OR RoB tool not matched to a prognostic-factor/prediction question (QUIPS/PROBAST) OR a domain enrichment module loaded without an in-question trigger

queries.query: Digital health interventions for medication adherence in chronic disease — scoping review of intervention types and outcomes measured
queries.regression_if: systematic-review PICO+GRADE forced onto a scoping question (RoB/GRADE are optional/omitted in PRISMA-ScR) OR PRISMA-ScR variant not used OR a domain enrichment module loaded for a domain-neutral question

pass_criteria: For each query: all expected P0–P7 phases run; every must_produce artefact present (PICO/PECO/PCC, search_strategy, screening_log, evidence_table, rob_assessments with the design-correct tool, grade_sof, prisma_flow_counts); NO must_not_fire domain module loads without an in-question context trigger (de-skew invariant); when enrichment DOES fire (may_fire) it appears as a labelled appendix, not in the core SR sections. PRISMA flow counts are honest (connector-limited counts flagged, never fabricated). Clinical-impact outputs cross-validated against an authoritative source (G-XVAL). No web scraping/fabrication for documented-gap sources (web tier removed v1.4.0).
deskew_note: De-skew regression is the headline of v9.0.0: the default review path is general PRISMA (P0–P7); the 11 domain layers are optional, context-triggered enrichment modules (G-DESKEW asserts none is mandatory in SKILL.md's default path). A domain-neutral question (Q03) that pulls in oncology/hematology/turkiye/etc. enrichment is a de-skew regression. When a question genuinely enters a domain (Q04), the module fires but its output is a labelled appendix, never the core SR sections.
